Dear Circadian City Citizen,

It was a long but fun week for us. We organized board game nights at Corot Park. There was a large attendance.  The last game took two nights!!!

During the day, we worked, mostly at the office, indoor. We tried to figure out how we can define interests in the game.

This city has all kind of people enjoying different interests. Manga, horror movies, karaoke, Mexican food, synth wave, yoga are only some of them.  You see, there are many different types of people in town, and we would like to make them happy as far as we can.

Well, on our side, it’s good to have these people from different worlds cause we know that this is how a culture gets rich. So, now, we are taking notes about how these interests will work on building friendships… It seems that the more you learn and educate yourself on your friends’ interests, the closer you get. But you must be careful because there are also negative interests!

So you should be wise while choosing your interests because our friends may have different tastes and they may not want to get close with somebody who has their negative interests…

Anyway, let's focus on the good side of this. There will be different locations for getting interests points; a bookshop, a steampunk cafe (yes, there is this Astro cafe with clockwork gears) and LP shop (like the one in High Fidelity movie) and… and many more.

The thing is, in Circadian City, your life gets bigger with your interests. The more you learn about your interests, the closer you get with your friends, and the world starts to unfold in different ways.

It seems like we are going to continue on this one for another week (Plus we have a chess tournament in Corot Park on Sunday morning)

[h1] ART PROGRESS [/h1]

So, see you, Citizen.

Live long and prosper!

[h1]In the mood for love?[/h1]

Hi Circadian City Citizen,

Last week, we talked about the stress factor that shapes our dreams and said that we'd be able to build our personalities in the dream universe. Maybe, it's better, for now, to talk about how we accumulate the stress and deal with it in Circadian City. 

During the day, we should take care of a lot of things: Money, hunger, energy, sociability, happiness, and stress. According to these, we developed the mood metric system.

The stress is the only metric the player try to keep low. There are many stress factors in the game. Higher stress affects the subconscious and dreams of the character as well as the quality of work, while low stress causes a decrease in overall productivity.

The stress level plays also a huge role in the sociability as well. If you are too stressed in the game, you won't be able to communicate with strangers. They may call you "crazy". But, how to lower the stress level? Maybe, you might ask your best friend for help or think about going to some relaxing activities. After all, it's totally up to you and your personality type. 

Moods define what you can and you can not do in the game. Even the romance works the same way. 
Do you want to fall in love? Just find your right mood and a good match.


[h1] ART PROGRESS [/h1]

We decided to use our Twitter account in a more active way. So, we focused on our marketing assets last week. If you are interested to know about other Circadian City Citizens, we advise you to follow us twitter.com/circadiancity .

[h1]Relax and sleep on it [/h1]

Hi Circadian City Citizen,

It's time to talk about the unique part of our game: you can play the dreams in it. Maybe it's a bit early to describe what it means "dream" in Circadian City. But we can reveal the idea behind the dream universe of our game. 

We believe that we build our personalities while sleeping. Generally, during the day - in real life-, we cannot find time to evaluate our feelings and/or our thoughts. Most of the time, we let ourselves go with the flow, and then we sleep on it. This is where our subconscious starts to work. It helps us to see what we missed during the day. 

The critical question for us as the developers of the game was to define what triggers a light dream or a nightmare. So, we created the stress level in the game. During the daytime of the game, you need to take care of your stress because that's going to shape your dream. If you are too stressed, you'll probably end up with a nightmare, and if you don't make the right moves in the dream state, you won't wake up full energetically. 

Stress accumulates over time, and it is possible to reduce it or decrease the rate of accumulation with specific activities and some cooking recipes, but having lots of energy and happiness helps a lot, as they reduce the rate of accumulation dramatically.

So this is the primary explanation behind the dream.

What does it mean "[b]close friend[/b]"? 
How many close friends can we handle in our lives? Is it the same amount for an introvert and an extrovert person?
Where is the line between friend and best friend?

notes.title: Thank you for the love so far, weekly updates are coming.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are a bunch of monkeys who were working on a script of Hamlet and we found ourselves developing Circadian City by an accident.

As a strange twist of fate, it seems that people like the concept of a life sim in a big city where we develop our personality in our dreams.

So we decided, we should keep you less stressed about the status of development by weekly updates on Steam and with the help of a newsletter.

In this update, I would like to tell you about how this journey started.

[h1]A very brief resume of humankind that are not so kind all the time[/h1]

A little while after the vertebrates leaving the oceans, some mammals adapted to the new environment and created a game called "The Sims". 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34773542/99266bf22006c916d52bb499a498d86b05f64b5d.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34773542/db6e62f2e46a92c3d26a71d1b2bc12955a4614d1.jpg[/img][/url]

Humans are known to fascinate the idea of projecting themselves on a platform and looking at their lives from a 3rd point of view since they've been painting on caves walls. Sims, helped that habit particularly well. 

Some time after, another monstrosity came to life and it caused the space-time continuum to shift due to the dangerously high levels of cuteness generated from it. It was Stardew Valley.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34773542/788c5a9cd313bfc5d602e721205e05ac9738343b.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34773542/9d4668649e40c355e4f76621021d8e77a1b3dbe1.jpg[/img][/url]

Stardew Valley seemed to satisfy all the needs of humans except the ones necessary for survival and reproduction. Some argue that it was the highest intellectual creation of humankind only to be compared with a cold beer in the afternoon.

Our monkeys, charged with the crimes of developing Circadian City are found playing these two games for no apparent reason. Later investigations showed the excessive amounts of playtimes on their Steam and Play Station accounts. 

It is still unknown if it was Nowhere Studios convincing Way Down Deep or vice versa to start working on a game like Circadian City. But it is believed that the concept below was the unusual halt of the Hamlet writing task. 

https://youtu.be/N5JwTbbEjw4

[url=www.circadiancity.com] Go to our webpage to join the newsletter  	[/url] and learn more about the project. You will be awarded by an exclusive ingame item. It will be a very useless item. Probably the most useless item in the game. Exclusively for you.
